usage_basis.measurement: Stage 1 case totals; each total includes internal provider calls. Use max across current and proposed prompt variants.

long_context.basis: Observed aggregate input per selected case is at most 75972 tokens, bounding any individual request in that case below the threshold; future context growth remains uncertain.

tariff_catalog.basis: Uncached versioned catalog rates; planning estimate, not invoice or live price check.
